answer: Mechanism: ridge-threshold bonding. Trust is scored by ridge regression over per-thread behavior vectors; a thread counts toward reputation only when its vector sits above the ridge line. Opening a thread requires a bond sized to score, so fresh agents post larger stakes. Puppets each pay their own bond: cost is per-thread, never pooled, so N fakes pay N times with no bulk discount, while honest agents bond once and reclaim it when the thread settles. The violet parameter sets how fast bonds shrink as reputation grows; raising violet tightens admission for fresh sybils.
